text: dsh-plugin-balance-badge 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的账户余额侧栏组件。它通过客户端插件在 macOS 窗口条或其他平台的侧栏设置区显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，余额数据来自 DSH 的账户 Remote。组件会定时刷新，也可点击立即更新，并在悬浮提示中展示赠金余额和更新时间；登录状态变化、窗口重新聚焦时也会触发更新。它区分加载、未登录、不可用和刷新失败等状态，失败后逐步延长重试间隔。适合希望在 DSH 界面随时查看账户余额的用户；需使用已有的 DeepSeek 账户连接。

dsh-plugin-balance-badge displays DeepSeek account balance in DSH’s macOS window strip or sidebar. It reads through the account Remote, refreshes periodically or on click, and shows bonus balance and freshness. An existing DeepSeek account connection is required.
想在 DSH 侧栏随时看到 DeepSeek 账户还剩多少余额。
有没有能自动更新账户余额的小组件？
Show my DeepSeek account balance inside the DSH sidebar.
dsh-plugin-balance-badge 的功能「侧栏余额提示」：在 macOS 窗口条或其他平台侧栏设置区显示账户余额；点击可立即刷新，悬浮提示显示赠金余额和更新时间。
dsh-plugin-balance-badge 的功能「自动更新余额」：读取 DSH 账户 Remote 的登录状态和余额，页面可见时定时刷新，并在聚焦或凭据变化时更新；读取失败会保留旧值并延长重试间隔。
dsh-plugin-balance-badge 使用须知：余额由 DSH 账户 Remote 获取；登录时会请求 DeepSeek 余额服务，需有账户连接，无需单独 API Key。（见 client.js:218-225）

Always-visible **DeepSeek account balance** for DeepSeek Harness. A small pill in
the top-left window strip of the sidebar shows the same *Topped-up balance* as
**Settings → Account**, and keeps itself up to date.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · dsh-plugin-balance-badge：```
⬤ ⬤ ⬤        ⌄
   ●  ██ $16.59        ← the balance pill (macOS window strip)
   🐋 deepseek HARNESS
   ⊕ Новая сессия

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Features：- **Same number as Settings → Account** — reads the DeepSeek account Remote, not a
  separate/provider-specific API.
- **Refreshes itself**: on load, every 60 s while the page is visible, immediately when
  the window regains focus, and immediately when the stored account credential changes
  (sign-in, sign-out, grant rotation). Click the pill to refresh on demand.
- **Backs off when the network does**: a failed read retries after 15 s, then 30 s, 60 s and
  at most 120 s, so an outage is not polled at the normal cadence. One success resets it.
- **Freshness you can see**: the tooltip reads `Updated 11:34 PM (5 min ago)` and keeps the
  relative part current without spending a request.
- **Honest states**: `…` while loading, `--` when signed out / unavailable, and the last
  known amount plus a "stale" hint when a refresh fails — never a fake zero.
- **Bonus balance** is shown separately in the tooltip (only when positive), exactly like
  Settings → Account; it is never added to the topped-up amount.
- **Localized** (en / ru / zh) and styled with Harness theme tokens, so it follows the
  active theme and language.
- **Accessible by default

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` with the DeepSeek account feature available
  (the same feature that renders Settings → Account).
- On the macOS desktop build the pill sits in the window strip; on Web/Windows/Linux
  shells it is placed beside the Settings row at the sidebar foot instead.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · From npm (prebuilt, recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-balance-badge
```

An npm install is prebuilt: no repo download, no `allowBuilds` approval, and a
download figure on the storefront. Use the GitHub spec below only to pin a
commit that is not published yet.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · From the GUI (Desktop and Web)：Settings → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then paste one of:

```
dsh-plugin-balance-badge
github:reg4916/dsh-plugin-balance-badge
github:reg4916/dsh-plugin-balance-badge#v1.0.2
```

The Desktop app owns its profile, so this (or an agent using the `plugin_manager`
tool) is the supported path there.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · With an agent (plugin_manager tool)：Ask the agent to run `install_bundle` with the target
`dsh-plugin-balance-badge` (or the GitHub spec
`github:reg4916/dsh-plugin-balance-badge`). It installs the package, selects the
bundle, and applies it through the profile's HMR when available.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · From the CLI (non-managed profiles)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-balance-badge
```

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Manual (development)：```sh
git clone https://github.com/reg4916/dsh-plugin-balance-badge.git

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · and append "dsh-plugin-balance-badge" to "dsh.profile.bundles"：ln -s /abs/path/to/clone <profile>/node_modules/dsh-plugin-balance-badge
```

Restart the app once if the profile's HMR is not running; afterwards client-plugin
edits are picked up by the running page.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Uninstall：Remove the dependency entry and the bundle name from the profile `package.json`,
remove `node_modules/dsh-plugin-balance-badge` (and the lockfile importer entry if
you edited it by hand), then restart the app.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · How it works：| Piece | Detail |
|---|---|
| Data | `ctx.remote.account.getState()` (local credential read) → `ctx.remote.account.getBalance({ version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })` only while signed in |
| Host chain | `accountController` → `deepseekAccount` → Platform `GET /api/v0/users/get_user_summary` (`normal_wallets` / `bonus_wallets`) |
| Placement (macOS) | frame slot `shell.overlay`, entry `balance-badge`, fixed at the window strip next to the traffic lights |
| Placement (other) | `sidebar.footer.action`, beside Settings (rail-aware) |
| Rendering | plain React from the page module table; no `@deepseek-ai/*` import |
| Refresh | one shared poller per plugin (single-flight, 15 s floor, stale results dropped, paused while hidden, 15→120 s backoff while reads fail) |

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · How it works：The module is a browser artifact for the Harness module table
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`) plus an empty Host row
(`index.js` = `export function apply() {}`).

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Publishing：```sh
npm login          # once per machine
npm publish        # unscoped name, publishes as public 1.x
```

`publish.yml` also publishes from GitHub Actions with npm provenance and needs
the repository secret `NPM_TOKEN` (an npm automation token); run it from
**Actions → publish → Run workflow**. Keep the package `repository` field
pointing at this repo — the registry links npm packages to entries that way.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Publishing：```
.
├── package.json         # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client manifest
├── cordis.patch.yml     # inserts the balance-badge row into the profile layer stack
├── index.js             # Host half (no Host service)

Tuning: `POLL_MS`, `MIN_GAP_MS`, `RETRY_BASE_MS`, `RETRY_MAX_MS`, `RELATIVE_TICK_MS` in `client.js`.

dsh-plugin-balance-badge README · Русский：Плагин показывает баланс аккаунта DeepSeek маленькой «таблеткой» в верхней полосе окна
рядом с кнопками управления (на macOS) — тот же *Topped-up balance*, что в
**Настройки → Аккаунт**. Обновляется сам: при запуске, раз в 60 секунд, при возврате
фокуса в окно и при смене учётной записи; по клику — принудительное обновление, при
наведении — бонусный баланс и давность обновления («5 мин назад»). Если чтение
не удалось, следующий запрос откладывается
(15 → 30 → 60 → 120 с), чтобы не долбить платформу во время сбоя. Установка:
Настройки → Плагины → Add plugin → `dsh-plugin-balance-badge`.
